newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won finishes lower on firmer dollar/yen.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won finishes lower on firmer dollar/yen.

text.p: The won closed weaker on Friday depressed by buying of the dollar following the U.S. unit's strength against the Japanese yen in the world markets, traders said.
The won ended at 828.90 after opening at an intraday high of 828.30. It hit a low of 829.30 in early morning.
"There were some government procurement and import deals, but they were balanced out by inflow of foreign capital," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the local currency's movement would be pegged to that of the dollar/yen on Monday.
"If the dollar surges against the yen, the won could fall below the support of 830," said the dealer. The 830 level has played an important psychological support for the past month.
Traders said the won was expected to trade in a range of 828 to 830 on Monday if the dollar/yen rate stayed quiet. The base mid-rate is seen at 828.90 compared with today's 827.90.
